mapper.select: SELECT SUM(T1.BID_PRIN_AMT) bidPrinAmt, GROUP_CONCAT(concat_ws('', T1.BID_PRICE * 100 ,'%') ORDER BY T1.BID_PRICE SEPARATOR ',') bidPrice, T3.IS_WIN isWin, SUM(T2.WIN_PRIN_AMT) winPrinAmt, T3.BID_ID bidId FROM ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE T1 LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID=T2.ENTRUST_ID and T1.BID_PRICE = T2.BID_PRICE LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER T3 ON T2.BID_ID=T3.BID_ID WHERE T1.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} GROUP BY (T3.IS_WIN, T3.BID_ID)
